name: files
notes: Chunk i of n: blob = seal(fileKey, plaintext[i*CHUNK, (i+1)*CHUNK), aad = passholder/v3/file/<id>/<i>/<n>), same blob format as entries (Base64(0x01 || nonce(12) || ciphertext || tag(16)), AES-256-GCM). Keys and nonces are hex. blobSha256 is the SHA-256 (hex) of the UTF-8 bytes of each Base64 blob string, not of the decoded bytes. A file with contentRule has no content: generate size bytes with byte[i] = (i * 31 + 7) & 0xff. Entry payloads are compact JSON in canonical key order (attachments between custom and hlc, descriptor keys id, name, mime, size, chunks, sha256, key). A merged entry is {...winner, attachments: mergeAttachments(winner, loser), hlc: merge.hlc}. Host steps run in order against one fresh store with the given epoch and now; storage steps use a separate store of the given capacity (sum of stored blob lengths). A step with expand has its request field replaced before sending: ids = count copies of repeat, blob = repeat repeated count times. Orphan: each file is one chunk stored at createdAt; expected ids are sorted (order is not significant). The host request is the decoded JSON value passed as-is (it may be null, a string or any non-object, which gives 400). Validation comes first (400, even with another epoch), then the epoch check (200 {epoch}), then the operation; on put, 400 chunk count mismatch is checked before 409 chunk differs. The main host store has unlimited capacity; only the storage steps use a limited one. status answers a duplicated id once per occurrence. TS JSON parsing accepts 1.0 as the number 1, so Kotlin must treat 1.0 as the integer 1 for size, chunks and index (entry 8 has size written as 1.0 in its raw payload; canonicalPayload is the re-serialized form). A descriptor's sha256 is the SHA-256 of the plaintext file (before chunking and encryption). The entry AAD is passholder/v2/entry/<id>, as in v3.json. Name and mime lengths count UTF-16 units; a name may contain U+00A0 but no C0 controls, U+007F-U+009F, / or \.

entries.description: entry after an attachment merge (winner's list, then the loser's missing ids)
name of exactly 255 UTF-16 units containing a surrogate pair (U+1F600)
empty mime and a mime of 127 characters
name containing U+00A0 (not a forbidden character)
size written as 1.0 in the payload text: accepted as the integer 1 (payload is the raw text, canonicalPayload the canonical form)

merge.description: winner's list, then the loser's missing ids in the loser's order
missing winner list counts as empty
same id on both sides: the winner's descriptor is kept

steps.description: put the same chunk again (no change)
put a different blob for a stored chunk
put with another chunk count and a different blob for a stored chunk: 400 takes precedence over 409
status answers a duplicate id once per occurrence
get a chunk of an unknown file
get an index beyond the file's chunk count
malformed request with another epoch: 400 (validation before the epoch check)
malformed unknown op with another epoch: 400
the put with another epoch stored nothing
malformed: get with a bad id
malformed: status with a bad id
malformed: status ids not a list
put a blob of exactly MAX_FILE_BLOB_LENGTH
